source: Hand-authored, not driven through this cassette engine's own recorder like the PUCO/RENAPER slice-6 cassettes: otp_send.py's _enviar_meta() hardcodes the endpoint host as https://graph.facebook.com/{graph_version}/{phone_number_id}/messages with NO env override (unlike PUCO's SISA_URL or RENAPER's TOKEN_URL/USERINFO_URL), so there is no way to point the real client at a local in-process fake upstream without editing otp_send.py itself — out of scope for this slice (connector production code is not touched). The request/response shape below matches otp_send.py's own _enviar_meta() request construction (messaging_product/to/type/text.body) and the WhatsApp Cloud API's documented send-message response (messaging_product/contacts[].input+wa_id/messages[].id — the exact fields otp_send.py reads: result['messages'][0]['id']), cross-checked against docs/architecture/chat-y-whatsapp.md's 'Outbound is its own provider seam' note. phone_number_id below is a placeholder (999999999999999), not humanrounds-pinamar's real Meta asset id documented in that architecture file. Every value is a repo test fixture, never a real patient's phone number. Field-shaped PII (to/contacts[].input/contacts[].wa_id) is tokenized the same way tests/cassettes/_vcr.py's recorder would via tests/cassettes/meta/fields.py's PII_FIELDS, applied by hand here. Re-author or, if otp_send.py ever grows a base-URL override, genuinely re-record (scripts/record_cassette.py --connector meta --scenario enviar_texto_ok) against a real (test) Meta number, diff-review before committing, per Area 3's doctrine.
